diseases.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
diseases.inv: ANA, anti-dsDNA, complement, CBC, urine protein, creatinine; specialist care.
diseases.tool: ACR/EULAR classification criteria are for research classification; apply by specialists.
diseases.alt: Rheumatoid arthritis, viral illness, drug-induced lupus

diseases.name: Sjogren syndrome
diseases.inv: Schirmer test, anti-Ro/La antibodies, salivary gland assessment.

diseases.name: Raynaud phenomenon / systemic sclerosis
diseases.inv: ANA, nailfold capillaroscopy; look for skin tightening and reflux.

diseases.name: Dermatomyositis / inflammatory myopathy
diseases.inv: CK, EMG, muscle biopsy, ANA; malignancy screening.

diseases.name: Gouty arthritis
diseases.inv: Joint aspiration (crystals), serum uric acid, creatinine.
diseases.tool: Septic arthritis must be excluded when a joint is hot and swollen.

diseases.name: Axial spondyloarthritis (e.g. ankylosing spondylitis)
diseases.tool: ASAS criteria classify axial SpA; apply by specialists.

diseases.name: Anterior uveitis
diseases.inv: Slit-lamp examination by ophthalmologist; screen for associated systemic disease.

diseases.name: Giant cell arteritis
diseases.inv: Urgent ESR/CRP and specialist review; early treatment may be needed to protect vision.

diseases.name: Rheumatoid arthritis (hand joint pattern)
diseases.tool: ACR/EULAR criteria apply to defined populations.

flags.text: New temple headache or jaw pain with visual symptoms over age 50: possible giant cell arteritis, urgent
